meta.connection: Staying safe and guarded on the mat before you trust a partner is the same guard you use before you trust a room. Both are smart. Naming it is the work.

body.text: Hand Touch / Knee Touch Collection Game

items: Whoever gets three touches first wins the round. The same rule applies to both players.
The bottom player holds as long as he keeps his connections.
The top player wins by breaking every connection and touching the bottom player's body with his shin, from outside his legs.
The top player holds the pin.
The bottom player wins by pushing the top player off and getting his legs back in front.
